Sun Wu (Sun Tzu), 吴之将军. A lean Chinese military strategist around 42, angular face, high cheekbones, sharp focused eyes, straight firm brows, short restrained black moustache and neat short pointed beard; disciplined, reserved, observant, no smile. Hair tied under a simple dark low-profile cloth military cap, a charcoal-brown robe with understated Eastern Zhou leather/lamellar shoulder protection and muted dark reddish-brown collar. A scholar-general, no helmet covering face, no weapons. Face visibly different from Confucius, younger and leaner.

portraits.name: 管仲
portraits.prompt:
Create ONE entirely new character portrait of Guan Zhong (管仲), statesman and chief minister of Qi, for the Chinese historical game 春秋·列国志. Requested deliverable square 512 x 512. This is a NEW FACE DESIGN, not a likeness-preserving edit, and must not look like the conventional long-bearded Confucius sage.

CHARACTER DESIGN FIRST:
A vigorous mature Chinese man about 50. A distinctly broad, stocky, almost square head, LOW broad forehead, broad fleshy cheeks and a heavy square lower jaw. Deep-set relatively narrow eyes beneath thick mostly STRAIGHT horizontal brows. A broad sturdy nose with a blunt rounded tip and wide nose bridge. Slightly asymmetric lips, firmly closed with a very subtle confident knowing half-smile. Sun-weathered warm tan skin, subtle facial texture. An intelligent, practical administrator who has also known trade and hardship: alert, astute, composed, grounded, quietly formidable, with human warmth. Never a villain caricature.
Facial hair is CRITICAL: a SHORT close-cropped thick dark beard hugging chin and jaw, approximately one or two centimeters, compact rounded-square shape, separate short dense moustache above upper lip. Just a few gray hairs at temples. NO long beard, NO flowing beard, NO pointed goatee, NO beard reaching the collar, NO long drooping moustache. The uncovered jaw silhouette and broad cheek mass must be immediately readable. This short facial hair and wide lower face are the portrait's strongest identity features.
Dark hair drawn back under a LOW close-fitting black-brown cloth wrap with a narrow simple band, leaving a clear low hairline. NO tall rectangular scholar's cap, NO sage cap, NO cascading headdress ribbons, NO modern haircut, NO modern hat. Understated Eastern Zhou / Spring and Autumn inspired cross-collar official robe in warm dark umber with a desaturated brown-green shoulder layer and muted ivory inner collar. Minimal plain bronze-colored fastening. No imperial regalia.
Position: shoulders slightly turned toward the viewer's right and face looking nearly forward with a slight turn toward the viewer's left. A generous chest-up crop, WHOLE headwear visible with a clear top margin. Broad substantial shoulders. Facial features large and distinct for a 48px thumbnail; eyes sharply legible, no tiny head.

ART DIRECTION:
Premium hand-painted semi-realistic Chinese historical strategy-game portrait. Warm aged xuan paper / ivory parchment ground (#f6efe0), very restrained sepia ink wash, dry-brush textures dissolving along lower shoulders, delicate painterly but lifelike facial shading. Warm natural skin, charcoal ink, earth brown and subdued gray-green. Gentle soft side light, clear value separation from pale backdrop. Subtle paper grain and a faint diffuse pale ink wash, no scenery. The SAME cohesive ink-and-paper aesthetic as an elegant Spring and Autumn historical portrait set, but this is its OWN distinctive person. It must read as a practical forceful political minister, not a serene thin-faced philosopher.
One person, one square portrait filling the canvas, no lettering, no calligraphy, no seal, no watermark, no frame, no UI. No weapons, books, tools or hands. No anime, no chibi, no 3D, no photographic skin, no fantasy, no Qing clothes, no winged later-period official hat. Avoid long narrow face, high domed forehead, fine elongated nose, arched thin brows, and especially flowing gray sage beard.
